blockers.summary: Assignment expects intake to refuse a manifest whose calibration_sha256 mismatches the actual data file (metadata_rejected + science token). Code at HEAD only pattern-validates the digest; nothing recomputes it against data bytes, so the upload is accepted (probe D2 fails with observed 201). AC-L03's normative text (requirements.yaml:405) requires refusal only for missing units / missing calibration / malformed input, so this is an assignment-vs-authority mismatch, not a demonstrated AC violation. Architect 33-ArchL03 concurs (LOW hardening). Owner decision needed: either add digest-vs-data verification at intake, or record that calibration_sha256 is a researcher claim about the calibration reference (never the data file) and amend the assignment expectation/docs to say so explicitly.

Assignment expects run-start to refuse a held ProbeInput whose calibration digest was swapped post-upload, with zero side effects. Run-start revalidation is structural only (ProbeInput.model_validate_json) and the one-use approval binds the ResearchIntent digest, not input_sha256, so the tampered document runs to completion (probe E fails with observed 201, 4 versions committed). The swapped digest is pinned into durable run provenance (disclosure, not prevention). Structural tamper IS refused (named test green). Architect 33-ArchL03 rates LOW hardening, not an AC failure. Owner decision needed: pin input_sha256 (or the full ProbeInput document) at approval/run-start, or document that post-upload input tampering is detectable-in-provenance by design.
